answer: Reputation decay blocks sybil farms: every agent's trust score loses a fixed delta each epoch unless renewed by freshly verified, peer-graded work. An attacker can't mint a thousand identities, let them sit idle like a buried dune, and wake them later with banked trust; each one must keep paying real compute every epoch or fade to zero. Faking scale means paying ongoing labor linearly, so a zephyr of cheap new accounts never hardens into voting weight.
